reviews.t: For the money and portability nice choice
reviews.x: Ok, its not gonna be as powerful as an electric water pik but I didn't expect it to., I do, however, think it has plenty of force to push food out between your teeth, is nice and portable and for the price seems well made. The directions say you can use the unit with mouthwash. I use Spry oral rinse in the chamber which contains xylitol to further improve cavity and bacteria prevention. All in all a good device - inexpensive- efficient and most of all very portable. One note - DO NOT remove the

reviews.t: Good for a Manual Flosser
reviews.x: I used this flosser to remove tonsil stones. It works well, but is not as smooth as an electric pump flosser/water pick. I like that you can very the intensity by pressing more or less firmly.

reviews.t: works great. just had a tooth pulled and this gives ...
reviews.x: works great. just had a tooth pulled and this gives me an effective way to irrigate the gum cavity.  Light way.  this will travel well.

reviews.t: Not good
reviews.x: I wasn't expecting this to be comparable to a water pick, but after trying it out I think a squirt gun from the dollar store would have worked better.

reviews.t: One Star
reviews.x: Horrible!! someone throwing water at your teeth would have more water pressure than this thing. Literally useless

reviews.t: While this flosser is convenient, it is messy nonetheless ...
reviews.x: While this flosser is convenient, it is messy nonetheless. I would purchase this again as gifts for family and friends just because, if flossing is important to you then this can be used anywhere and is small enough to fit in your purse without having to worry about cords or batteries.

reviews.t: Horrible!
reviews.x: This stinks!  First off, this does not work like it does on the commercials.  Second, mine is broken and I didn't read the fine print that there are no returns. Buyer beware - don't buy this!

reviews.t: Waste of money.
reviews.x: This is truly nothing.  No matter how much you pump it there,  is no stream of water it just dribbles out.  I'm sorry I even tried, don't waste your money. There is no dental care involved.

reviews.t: Simple water flossing
reviews.x: I think I will appreciate it more when traveling. Very low water pressure, so not comparable to something with a motor. Still good to use along with brushing at the end of the day.

reviews.t: I found it awkward to attempt to squirt with the ...
reviews.x: I found it awkward to attempt to squirt with the button and align the end with your teeth at the same time.  I prefer my waterpik.

reviews.t: I PROTEST!
reviews.x: This flosser works as advertised, came promptly, was packaged well, and is probably as good as a manual pump water flosser can be. BUT it had a BIG bright yellow sticker along one entire side of the water reservoir, repeating information detailed clearly in the printed instructions.  That sticker was impossible to remove cleanly.  Yes, I know about the hairdryer, vinegar, peanut butter, Goo-Gone, and so on.  I even resorted to a razor blade.  There is still ugly, germ-trapping adhesive on this p

reviews.t: It's a dolor store squirt gun!!!
reviews.x: I was VERY disappointed with this product.  It's just a glorified kid's water pistol.  Save yourself some money and go to the dollar store and get a squirt gun.  I expected it to pump up similar to a garden sprayer and have some pressure.  The only pressure depends how much you want to push the button.  There's no "Technology" involved!  Also it's "non refundable".  Unfortunately I purchased two.  I can understand not being able to return an opened one, but an unopened one?

reviews.t: Works great, just breaks too soon!
reviews.x: Have purchased 3 of these and they all broke within 3 months! The gasket rubber seal fails, it starts leaking and stops spraying at full power. The rubber gasket becomes so messed up that it becomes harder and harder to twist the cap off to put in more water. Product works great, they just need to fix this issue.

reviews.t: Best flosser ever! So much better than battery powered.
reviews.x: LOVE these. They do a better job of flossing than regular dental floss for sure and are so much easier to boot. I have one for travel and one I use every day.

reviews.t: does not clean your mouth at all
reviews.x: Terrible no power at all, it squirts a gentle sprit does not clean your mouth at all

reviews.t: not powerful enough
reviews.x: not powerful enough but still can help a little

reviews.t: Manual Dental Irrigator is Very Good
reviews.x: Well worth the $8 for convenience (compact and light to travel with), affordability and effectiveness.  No waterpic unless it blasts your dentin off is going to do the job of floss between the the teeth or the toothbrush on the outer surfaces.  But this tool has become the 3rd leg of my 3 leg dental upkeep arsenal, I lost the cap to my powered unit and tried this one.  If you have a filling that has dropped out of service - this tool with warm (body temp) water will evacuate just about anything

reviews.t: Saved my mouth when I didn't yet have insurance but half my tooth fell out X_x
reviews.x: This is small, quiet, and doesn't require a plug to operate. I found it *extremely* helpful when I had a deep cavity but needed to wait a month for my dental insurance to kick in before I could have it filled. I would fill this with a solution of half hydrogen peroxide, half water, and use it to irrigate the cavity site every time I ate or drank anything other than water. My dentist tells me this rigorous rinsing helped prevent the cavity from becoming an abscess, so thank you Dental Care Water

reviews.t: A terrfic item that is handy, clever & actually works
reviews.x: This is my second purchase and I can't say enough about how simple & effective this gizmo is at getting little food particles my toothbrush misses. It's more fun than flossing and works just as well.  No batteries or electricity. I fill it up with a combination of mouthwash and water and am amazed at how efficiently it works. It's so good that I keep the second one at work for when I get back from lunch.  My biggest suggestion though is to buy one for the kids. They will love using this little &

reviews.t: I love my dental care water flosser
reviews.x: I love my dental care water flosser. I use it daily so it makes flossing convenient and relatively easier. I fill it with a combination of water and mouth wash. It doesn't have the power of the rechargeable versions but I had to send my rechargeable back to the factory at least twice. It also doesn't completely replace manual flossing but it is a great way to keep a lot of food from between your tooth spaces and to keep your breath fresher. Highly recommended as part of your 2 times per day rout

reviews.t: The first one star
reviews.x: The first one star I've given in my life. I got one of my teeth extracted and I needed a teeth washer to clean up the hole left. This product generates a weak wash when the tail is up. However, as long as you turn it a little bit, it begins to leak and no water is out! It's not possible to use it to wash my teeth.

reviews.t: Not an impressive device but it has what I wanted.
reviews.x: I bought this manual waterpick to see if the stream pressure was suitable for my use. The electric models I have used try to 'blast' away debris, which can be harmful on weak tissues. This pick is now a part of my daily oral cleaning routine, as the pressure does not cause bleeding.

reviews.t: I would not recommend this for anyone
reviews.x: I threw this away a week after I got it.  I tried and tried to use it for tonsil lavage and it just did not work.  I can't imagine using it as a water pick.  I would not recommend this for anyone.  The more pricey ones are worth the added expense.

reviews.t: More like a Watery Mess.
reviews.x: This didn't work for me. I tried on 2 occasions to fill the water as prescribed on the directions but it's just one big wet mess. I'll leave it to the dentists and use regular floss.

reviews.t: The price is good if you only need a drizzle of water
reviews.x: Depending on what you need this for it may not be right for you. I needed a water flosser , this one has no flossing force ! The price is good if you only need a drizzle of water !

claims.text: Many reviewers find the water pressure too weak, describing it as dribbling or like a squirt gun rather than a proper flosser.
Several reviewers praise its portability and convenience for travel, noting it is small and cordless.
Some reviewers report durability problems, with units breaking or leaking within a few months.
A few reviewers find it awkward to operate, particularly aligning and pumping the button while using it.
Some reviewers consider it good value for the price and well made for a manual flosser.
